blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: A central yet under-explored question in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) is where to connect---how visual information from a hierarchical vision encoder should be wired into the layer-wise semantics of a large language model. Mainstream MLLMs inject a fixed single-layer visual representation into the LLM and treat all LLM layers as a single consumer, ignoring that different layers demand different visual granularities. Recent multi-layer fusion methods either compress hierarchical features on the encoder side or rely on predefined sparse or hierarchical layer-to-layer connections, and therefore stop short of modeling adaptive cross-layer interactions between the ViT and LLM hierarchies. We address this gap with DGP (Dynamic Gated Pathways), a routing mechanism that establishes all-to-all connections between every ViT layer and every LLM layer, with each LLM layer dynamically gating its preference over visual layers conditioned on its own semantic state. Built on top of LLaVA-1.5-7B and 13B, DGP delivers consistent gains over the LLaVA-1.5-7B baseline (e.g., +4.2 on SQA$^{I}$, +3.3 on MM-Vet, +3.1 on VizWiz and LLaVA$^{W}$) and surpasses prior multi-layer visual fusion methods on most benchmarks. Layer-wise routing analyses further show that different LLM layers do select different visual granularities on demand, supporting both the effectiveness and interpretability of the proposed dynamic gated pathways. The code is available: https://github.com/YingyingYan1/DGP.
blocks.zh: 在多式联运大语言模型(MLLMs)中,一个尚未得到充分探讨的中心问题是,从分级视觉编码器中连接-如何的视觉信息应当被连接到一个大语言模型的分层语义中。 主流MLLMs在LLM中注入固定的单层视觉表现,并将所有LLM层作为一个单一的消费者对待,忽略了不同的层要求不同的视觉颗粒. 最近的多层聚变方法要么压缩编码器侧面的分级特征,要么依赖预先定义的稀疏或分级的层对层连接,从而停止模拟VIT和LLM阶梯之间的适应性跨层相互作用. 我们通过DGP(Dynamic Gated Pathways)来解决这一缺口,这个路由机制在每一个VIT层和每一个LLM层之间建立了全方位的连接,每个LLM层动态地标注着它相对于视像层的偏好,以自身的语义状态为条件. DGP建在LLaVA-1.5-7B和13B之上,提供与LLaVA-1.5-7B基线一致的增益(例如,在SQA$^{I}$上+4.2,在MM-Vet上+3.3,在VizWiz和LLaVA$^{W}$上+3.1),并在大多数基准上超过了以前的多层视觉聚变方法. 逐层的路由分析进一步表明,不同的LLM层确实根据需求选择了不同的视觉颗粒,支持了拟议的动态门径的有效性和可解释性. 该代码可查询:https://github.com/Yingying Yan1/DGP.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) [ 19 , 3 , 21 , 16 ] encode an image with a pretrained vision backbone [ 32 , 31 , 42 ] , project the resulting features through an adapter, and inject the visual tokens into a language model. In this paradigm, the effectiveness of visual information depends not only on the representational power of the encoder [ 38 , 7 , 34 ] , but—more critically—on where to connect : how the visual tokens are wired into the internal layers of the LLM.
blocks.zh: 多式联运大语言模型(MLLMs) [19, 3, 21, 16] 编码了具有被预先训练的视觉主干线的图像 [32, 31, 42] ,通过适配器预测所形成的特性,并给视觉符号注入语言模型. 在这个范式中,视觉信息的有效性不仅取决于编码器的表示力[38,7,34],而且——更重要的是——在连接的地方:视觉符号如何被接入LLM的内部层.

blocks.en: As illustrated in Figure 1 , attention patterns across ViT layers differ markedly: shallow layers attend to edges, textures, and local details, whereas deeper layers progressively concentrate on a small number of semantic anchors. Yet, most MLLMs [ 2 , 25 , 10 ] simply forward the output of one fixed ViT layer (typically the last or penultimate layer) to the LLM, as illustrated in Figure 2 (A), effectively collapsing the image into a single-granularity semantic representation. Connecting the LLM only to the terminal deep layer therefore discards shallow- and mid-level cues and prevents the LLM’s layer-wise semantics from interacting with the full visual hierarchy.
blocks.zh: 如图1所示,整个ViT层的注意模式明显不同:浅层涉及边缘、纹理和局部细节,而更深层则逐渐集中于少数语义锚地。 然而,如图2(A)所显示的,大多数MLLM[2,25,10]只是将一个固定的VIT层(通常为倒数第二层)的输出推向LLM,有效地将图像折叠成单格语义代表. 将 LLM 只连接到终端深层, 因此会丢弃浅层和中层的提示, 并阻止 LLM 的分层语义与全视觉结构交互 。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Attention distributions across ViT layers. Shallow layers show dispersed attention over edges and textures; deeper layers progressively concentrate on a few semantic anchors.
blocks.zh: 图1:跨VIT层的注意力分布. 浅层显示在边缘和纹理上分散了注意力;更深层逐渐地集中在几个语义锚上.

blocks.en: Figure 2: Strategies for visual token insertion. (A) Fixed single-layer connection. (B) Encoder-side fusion of multiple ViT layers into one representation. (C) Predefined sparse or hierarchical connections between ViT and LLM layers. (D) DGP (Ours): dynamic gated pathways between all ViT and all LLM layers. w m w_{m} denotes the routing weights that LLM layer m m assigns across all ViT layers.
blocks.zh: 图2:视觉符号插入战略。 (A) 固定的单层连接。 (B) 编码器-侧式将多层VIT聚成一个代表. (C) 预定义的VIT和LLM层之间的稀有或分级连接. (D) DGP (Ours): 在所有ViT和所有LLM层之间的动态入门路径. w m w_{m}表示LLM层 m 所分配的跨所有VIT层的路由权重.

blocks.en: Two lines of work have started to expose multi-layer visual features to the LLM, but each falls short on the where to connect question. Encoder-side fusion [ 39 , 4 , 20 , 23 , 36 ] merges multi-layer features into one representation before the LLM (Figure 2 (B)); any dynamism is consumed inside the encoder and cannot adapt to the differentiated demands of individual LLM layers. Predefined sparse or hierarchical connections [ 30 , 43 , 37 , 8 ] wire selected ViT layers to specific LLM layers (Figure 2 (C)), typically using hand-crafted connection patterns or fixed hierarchical mappings. CLI [ 5 ] introduces adaptive gating conditioned on the current LLM state, but operates over sampled ViT layers and designated LLM injection points. Neither category explicitly models the adaptive , dynamic cross-layer interactions between all ViT layers and all LLM layers that the question of where to connect demands.
blocks.zh: 两行作品开始将多层视觉特征暴露在LLM上,但每行在连接问题的位置上都不足. 编码器侧聚[39,4,20,23,36]在LLM(图2(B))之前将多层特征合并为一个代表;任何活性在编码器内部被消耗,无法适应单个LLM层的不同需要. 预定义的稀有或分级连接[30,43,37,8] 有线所选取的ViT地层到特定的LLM地层(图2(C)),一般使用手工制作的连接模式或固定分级绘图. CLI [5] 引入了以当前LLM状态为条件的适应性地标,但在所抽样的VIT层和指定的LLM注射点上运行. 两个分类都明确模拟了所有VIT层和所有LLM层之间的适应性,动态的跨层相互作用,这些相互作用是在哪里连接需求的问题.

blocks.en: Predictive coding in visual neuroscience suggests that perception is not a unidirectional feed-forward process but a hierarchical feedback loop that continuously modulates activations across layers [ 33 ] . We take this as inspiration to revisit visual token injection: visual evidence should not be delivered in one shot through a fixed pathway, but should keep participating in the LLM’s representation updates through dynamic cross-layer pathways. Building on this view, we introduce DGP (Dynamic Gated Pathways), which connects all ViT layers to all LLM layers via learned, dynamically gated routes (Figure 2 (D)).
blocks.zh: 视觉神经科学中的预测编码表明,感知不是一个单向的向导反馈过程,而是一种分级反馈循环,持续地调节跨层活化[33]. 我们将此视为重新审视视觉信号注射的灵感:视觉证据不应该通过固定路径一发而发出,而应该通过动态跨层路径继续参与LLM的表达更新. 在这个观点的基础上,我们引入了DGP(Dynamic Gated Pathways),它通过有知识的动态入门路线(图2(D))将所有ViT层与所有LLM层相接.

blocks.en: Concretely, the outputs of different ViT layers act as candidate representations at varying granularities. At every LLM layer, DGP produces a routing distribution over all ViT layers from the current hidden state, aggregates the candidates via gated weighted fusion, and injects the result back into the layer’s visual hidden states through a residual connection. The hierarchical visual evidence keeps supplying cues for language reasoning, while the LLM’s layer-wise semantic state drives the preference over visual hierarchies, yielding a cross-layer, progressively evolving vision–language interaction that integrates low-level details and high-level semantics on demand at different decoding depths.
blocks.zh: 具体地说,不同ViT层的产出在不同的颗粒处充当候选人代表。 在每层LLM中,DGP会从当前隐藏状态产生所有ViT层的通路分布,通过入门加权聚变来汇总候选者,并通过剩余连接将结果注入层的视觉隐藏状态. 分级视觉证据不断为语言推理提供提示,而LLM的分层语义状态则驱动着比视觉分级的偏好,产生跨层、逐渐发展的视觉-语言互动,在不同的解码深度将低层次细节和高层次语义需求融合在一起。

blocks.en: We instantiate DGP on top of LLaVA-1.5 [ 25 ] and further validate it on Qwen3-VL-2B [ 3 ] and LLaVA-NeXT [ 26 ] . Across a wide range of multimodal benchmarks, DGP yields consistent improvements over baselines and outperforms prior multi-layer visual feature utilization methods. The learned routing patterns confirm that different LLM layers indeed prefer different visual granularities, alleviating the information bottleneck of fixed single-layer fusion. Our contributions are:
blocks.zh: 我们用LLaVA-1.5 [25] 和LLaVA-NEXT [26] 进一步验证它。 在一系列广泛的多模式基准中,DGP比基线得到持续改进,而且优于先前的多层次视觉特征利用方法。 所学的路由模式证实,不同的LLM层确实更喜欢不同的视觉颗粒,缓解了固定单层聚变的信息瓶颈. 我们的贡献是:

blocks.en: • We reframe visual information injection in MLLMs around the question of where to connect , and show that fixed single-layer inputs and predefined sparse or hierarchical connections cannot match the differentiated demands of hierarchical ViT representations and layer-wise LLM semantics. • We propose DGP (Dynamic Gated Pathways), an all-to-all cross-layer connection mechanism in which every LLM layer dynamically gates its preference over every ViT layer conditioned on its current semantic state. • We demonstrate the effectiveness and interpretability of DGP on multiple multimodal benchmarks, where layer-wise routing analyses reveal the adaptive, layer-dependent selection behavior of the proposed dynamic gated pathways.
blocks.zh: 二. 支助 我们将MLLMs的视觉信息注入重新设定为连接地点的问题,并显示固定的单层输入和预定义的稀有或分级连接无法匹配分级的ViT表示和分层的LLM语义的不同要求. ^ 我们提议DGP(Dynamic Gated Pathways),这是一个全相通的跨层连接机制,在这个机制中,每个LLM层都会动态地打开它相对于每个ViT层的偏好,并以它目前的语义状态为条件. ^ 我们在多种多模式基准上证明了多哈方案的有效性和可解释性,其中分层路由分析揭示了拟议动态入门路径的适应性和分层依赖性选择行为。

blocks.en: We reframe visual information injection in MLLMs around the question of where to connect , and show that fixed single-layer inputs and predefined sparse or hierarchical connections cannot match the differentiated demands of hierarchical ViT representations and layer-wise LLM semantics.
blocks.zh: 我们在 MLLMs 中围绕连接地点的问题重新构建视觉信息注入,并显示固定的单层输入和预定义的稀有或分级连接无法匹配分级的VIT表示和分层的LLM语义的不同要求.

blocks.en: We propose DGP (Dynamic Gated Pathways), an all-to-all cross-layer connection mechanism in which every LLM layer dynamically gates its preference over every ViT layer conditioned on its current semantic state.
blocks.zh: 我们提出DGP(Dynamic Gated Pathways),这是一个全相通的跨层连接机制,在这个机制中,每个LLM层都会动态地打开它相对于每个ViT层的偏好,并以它目前的语义状态为条件.

blocks.en: We demonstrate the effectiveness and interpretability of DGP on multiple multimodal benchmarks, where layer-wise routing analyses reveal the adaptive, layer-dependent selection behavior of the proposed dynamic gated pathways.
blocks.zh: 我们在多种多模式基准上证明了多哈方案的有效性和可解释性,其中分层路由分析揭示了拟议动态入门路径的适应性和分层依赖性选择行为。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Multimodal Large Language Model
blocks.zh: 2.1 多式联运大型语文模式

blocks.en: A typical Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM) couples a vision encoder, a vision–language adapter, and a large language model: the encoder turns the image into visual tokens, the adapter projects them into the language space, and the LLM consumes the joint visual–textual sequence to generate responses. Existing MLLMs mainly fall into two architectural families: projector-based decoder-only designs (e.g., LLaVA [ 25 ] , MiniGPT-4 [ 44 ] , Qwen-VL [ 2 ] , InternVL [ 10 ] ) and cross-attention-based designs (e.g., Flamingo [ 1 ] ).
blocks.zh: 一个典型的多模式大语言模型(MLLM)与一个视觉编码器,一个视觉-语言适配器,以及一个大型语言模型相配:编码器将图像转换为可视符号,适配器将图像投射到语言空间,而LLM会消耗联合可视-文字序列生成响应. 现有的MLLMs主要属于两个建筑家族:以投影为主的解码器唯一的设计(如LLaVA [25],MiniGPT-4 [44],Quen-VL [2],InternVL [10])和跨心设计(如Flamingo [1]).

blocks.en: Current MLLMs use pretrained vision backbones such as CLIP-ViT [ 32 ] and SigLIP [ 42 ] , all of which expose representations of varying granularities across their layers. Yet most pipelines project only a single fixed layer into the LLM, so the language model sees only one level of visual abstraction. The visual connection mechanism is not merely a cross-modal interface: it determines whether the rich, hierarchical visual representations can be accessed and reused inside the LLM.
blocks.zh: 目前的MLLMs使用CLIP-ViT [32]和SigLIP [42]等预受训练的视觉主干线,这些主干线都暴露出各层不同颗粒的表示. 然而大多数管线只将一个固定的地层投射入LLM,因此语言模型只看到一个层次的视觉抽象. 视觉连接机制不仅仅是一个跨模式界面:它决定了丰富的,分级的视觉表现能否在LLM内部访问并再用.

blocks.en: 2.2 Connection Strategies for Visual Token Insertion
blocks.zh: 2.2 视觉托肯插入的连接策略

blocks.en: Different ViT layers carry different semantic granularities: shallow layers retain local textures and spatial details, while middle and deep layers progressively encode object structures and high-level semantics [ 6 ] . A single deep layer is not always the best choice [ 6 ] , and exploiting the visual hierarchy depends as much on how layers are connected to the LLM as on which layers are selected [ 24 ] . The crux, in other words, is to establish effective connections between vision-encoder layers and LLM layers—i.e., the where to connect problem. Prior efforts can be grouped into two categories.
blocks.zh: 不同 ViT地层承载了不同的语义颗粒:浅地层保留了局部纹理和空间细节,而中深地层则逐渐地将物体结构和高层次语义编码为 [6]. 单层深层并不总是最佳选择[6],而利用视觉分级取决于地层如何与LLM相接,以及选择哪个地层[24]. 换言之,症结在于在视觉编码层和LLM层之间建立有效的联系——即连接问题的地点。 先前的努力可分为两类。

blocks.en: Unified Encoder-side Connections. Methods in this category fuse multi-layer visual features on the encoder side and pass a single unified representation to the LLM. DenseConnector [ 39 ] concatenates features from different ViT layers along the token or channel dimension. MMFuser [ 4 ] uses deep-layer features as queries to pull fine-grained information from shallow layers. IGVA [ 20 ] and TGIF [ 23 ] adjust ViT-layer weights conditioned on the instruction. CCRA [ 36 ] combines several attention mechanisms for text-conditioned region–semantic alignment. While these designs improve multi-layer feature utilization, the entire fusion happens before the LLM; the LLM still receives one homogenized input and cannot reach back into the visual hierarchy as decoding progresses.
blocks.zh: 统一编码器侧连接 。 这一类的方法将多层次的视觉特性接入编码器一侧,并传递给LLM的单一统一表示. DenseConnector [39] 将不同ViT层的特征从符号或通道维度上分出. MMFuser [4] 使用深层特征作为查询来从浅层取出精细的分层信息. IGVA [20] 和 TGIF [23] 调整以指令为条件的ViT层加权. CCRA [36] 结合了文本条件化区域-语义调整的若干关注机制. 虽然这些设计改进了多层特征利用,但整个聚变发生在LLM之前;LLM仍然接收到一个同源输入,在解码过程中无法回向到视觉层次.

blocks.en: Predefined Sparse or Hierarchical Connections. Methods in this category route hierarchical visual information to different LLM layers. DeepStack [ 30 ] distributes visual tokens across decoder depths according to a fixed hierarchical schedule. Sparse Shortcuts [ 43 ] wires ViT and LLM layers through predefined connection patterns. EVLM [ 8 ] feeds multi-layer ViT features into different gated cross-attention layers. CLI [ 5 ] applies adaptive gating at sampled vision layers and designated LLM injection points, rather than treating every ViT–LLM pair as a candidate connection. A more recent line of work [ 37 ] selects and fuses hierarchical visual features conditioned on each LLM layer’s representation. Although these methods begin to acknowledge the hierarchical correspondence between vision and language, most still rely on hand-crafted connection patterns or fixed layer-to-layer mappings, and few of them simultaneously realize (i) all-to-all cross-layer connectivity, (ii) routing weights driven by the current LLM-layer state, and (iii) end-to-end training with a stable routing distribution—the design point that DGP targets.
blocks.zh: 预定义的 Sparse 或分级连接 。 本类方法的路由分级可视化信息到不同的LLM层. DeepStack [30] 按照固定的分级时间表,在解码器深度之间分发视觉符号. Sparse快捷键 [43] 有线VIT和LLM层通过预定义的连接模式. EVLM [8] 将多层ViT特性输入到不同的门式相通层. CLI [5]在被抽样的视层应用适应性地标并指定了LLM注射点,而不是将每对ViT-LLM作为候选连接. 较近期的工作[37] 选择和导出以每个LLM层的表示为条件的分级视觉特征。 尽管这些方法开始承认视觉和语言之间的分级对应,但大多数仍然依赖于手动的连接模式或固定的层到层映射,很少有方法同时实现(一)全相通的跨层相通,(二)由当前LLM-层态所驱动的路由权重,(三)有稳定路由分布的端到端培训——DGP目标的设计点.

blocks.en: In summary, existing methods either compress the visual hierarchy into a single pre-LLM representation, or wire it into the LLM through predefined sparse or hierarchical connections; neither answers where to connect via dynamic cross-layer interactions between all ViT layers and all LLM layers. We close this gap with DGP , which establishes adaptive, all-to-all connections between ViT and LLM layers through dynamic gated pathways.
blocks.zh: 简而言之,现有方法要么将视觉分级压缩成单个前LLM代表,要么通过预先定义的稀有或分级连接将其接入LLM;要么没有答案通过所有VIT层和所有LLM层之间的动态跨层交互连接到哪里. 我们用DGP来填补这个空白, 它通过动态入门路径在VIT和LLM层之间建立了适应性的,全方位的连接.

blocks.en: 3 Methodology
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: Figure 3: Overview of DGP . (A) At every LLM layer, the Dynamic Gated Pathways module routes over all ViT layers conditioned on the current language-layer state, aggregates the selected visual features, and injects them back into the LLM hidden states through a gated residual connection—establishing all-to-all cross-layer connections between ViT and LLM. (B) Inside the module, ViT layer summaries serve as keys/values and the language-layer state as the query; a shared cross-attention followed by a layer-specific routing MLP produces the per-layer routing weights. Weight Matrix (m) denotes the routing weights of LLM layer m m over all ViT layers.
blocks.zh: 图3:全球采购概览 (A) 在每个LLM层上,动态Gated Pathways模块在所有ViT层的路由都以当前语言层状态为条件,将选定的视觉特征汇总起来,并通过一个有入门的剩余连接——在ViT和LLM之间建立全相通的跨层连接,将它们注入LLM隐藏状态. (B)在模块内部,ViT层摘要作为键/值,语言层状态作为查询;一个共享的交叉意向,然后是层特异的路由MLP产生每层路由权重. 重量矩阵 (m) 表示所有维T层上LLM层 m的通路权重.

blocks.en: Problem Formulation. In existing MLLMs, a single fixed visual representation is injected once and then propagates implicitly through the LLM [ 2 , 25 , 10 ] , leaving no direct cross-layer pathway between the visual hierarchy and the language hierarchy. As a result, different decoding stages cannot reach back to the visual granularity they actually need. DGP (Dynamic Gated Pathways) removes this bottleneck by opening dynamic gated pathways between every ViT layer and every LLM layer, so that each LLM layer can adaptively pick the visual hierarchy that best fits its current semantic state.
blocks.zh: 问题表述。 在现有MLLMs中,一次注入一个固定的视觉表现,然后通过LLM [2, 25, 10] 暗地传播,使得视觉分级和语言分级之间没有直接的跨层通道. 因此,不同的解码阶段无法回溯到它们实际需要的视觉颗粒. DGP(Dynamic Gated Pathways)通过在每个VIT层和每个LLM层之间打开动态的有门路径来去除这个瓶颈,这样每个LLM层就可以适应性地选择最适合其当前语义状态的视觉分级.

blocks.en: Let the vision encoder have L v L_{v} layers, with the output of the ℓ \ell -th layer ( ℓ = 1 , … , L v \ell=1,\dots,L_{v} ) denoted as 𝐗 v ( ℓ ) \mathbf{X}_{v}^{(\ell)} . blocks.zh: 4个实验

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Settings
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en: Implementation Details and Training Recipe. We follow the LLaVA-1.5 [ 25 ] training recipe, using CLIP-ViT-L/14-336 [ 32 ] as the vision encoder and Vicuna as the LLM backbone. Training proceeds in two stages: pre-training (PT) on LLaVA-558K [ 25 ] and supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on LLaVA-mixed-665K [ 25 ] . Because DGP interacts with the hidden states at every LLM layer, both stages jointly optimize the LLM together with the newly introduced DGP modules. The vision encoder is kept frozen throughout, and each stage is trained for one epoch.
blocks.zh: 执行细节和培训指南。 我们遵循LLaVA-1.5[25]培训配方,使用CLIP-ViT-L/14-336[32]作为视觉编码器和Vicuna作为LLM主干. 培训分两个阶段进行:关于LLaVA-558K的预训(PT)[25];关于LLaVA-混合-665K的有监督的微调(SFT)[25]. 由于DGP在每个LLM层上与隐藏状态相互作用,两个阶段都与新引入的DGP模块一起共同优化了LLM. 视觉编码器在整个过程中被保持被冷冻,每个阶段都接受一个时代的训练.

blocks.en: All hyperparameters follow LLaVA-1.5: AdamW with cosine scheduling (warmup ratio 0.03 0.03 ), batch sizes of 256 / 128 256/128 and learning rates of 1 × 10 − 3 / 2 × 10 − 5 1\times 10^{-3}/2\times 10^{-5} for PT/SFT, respectively. The routing MLP uses a hidden dimension of 1024 1024 , and the residual gate is initialized to 0.3 0.3 . Following TGIF [ 23 ] , the entropy regularizer uses λ = 0.01 \lambda=0.01 during PT and is disabled ( λ = 0 \lambda=0 ) during SFT so routing can specialize. More hyperparameter sensitivity results are provided in Appendix C .
blocks.zh: 所有超参数都跟随LLaVA-1.5: AdamW的同位素排程(温和比为0.03 0.03),批量尺寸为256/128 256/128,学习速度为1×10 − 3 / 2×10 − 5 1\times 10×-3}/2\times 10×5),分别为PT/SFT. 路由MLP采用1024-1024的隐藏尺寸,剩余出入口被初始化为0.3-0.3. 继TGIF [23]后, en常态器在PT期间使用QQ = 0.01\lambda=0.01,在SFT期间被禁用(QQ = 0\lambda=0),所以通路可以专用. 附录C提供了更多的超参数灵敏度结果。

blocks.en: Benchmarks. We evaluate on two complementary suites of multimodal benchmarks. Academic VQA covers GQA [ 15 ] , SciQA-IMG [ 29 ] , VQAv2 [ 13 ] , and VizWiz [ 14 ] . Instruction-following / LMM benchmarks cover SEED-Bench (SEED/SEED I ) [ 18 ] , LLaVA-Wild [ 27 ] , MM-Vet [ 40 ] , MMBench [ 28 ] , and POPE [ 22 ] , jointly probing multimodal comprehension, fine-grained perception, and hallucination resistance.
blocks.zh: 基准。 我们评价两个相辅相成的多模式基准组合。 学术VQA涵盖GQA [15],SciQA-IMG [29],VQAv2 [13],和VizWiz [14]. 指令遵循/LMM基准涵盖SEED-Bench(SEED/SEED I)[18],LLaVA-Wild[27],MM-Vet [40],MMBench [28],和POPE [22],共同探究多模式理解,精细感知和幻觉阻.

blocks.en: Baselines. We compare DGP against two groups of baselines. The first group consists of general-purpose MLLMs: BLIP-2 [ 19 ] , InstructBLIP [ 11 ] , Shikra [ 9 ] , IDEFICS [ 17 ] , Qwen-VL [ 2 ] , and LLaVA-1.5 [ 25 ] . The second group focuses on multi-layer visual feature utilization : MMFuser [ 4 ] , Dense Connector [ 39 ] , DeepStack-L [ 30 ] , Sparse Shortcuts [ 43 ] , IGVA [ 20 ] , and TGIF [ 23 ] . For a fair comparison, we focus on methods that share the Vicuna backbone and the LLaVA-1.5 configuration.
blocks.zh: 基线。 我们比较DGP和两组基线。 第一组由通用的MLLMs组成:BLIP-2 [19],指令BLIP [11],Shikra [9],IDDERICS [17],Qun-VL [2],和LLaVA-1.5 [25]. 第二组侧重于多层视觉特征利用:MMFuser [4], Dense Connector [39], DeepStack-L [30], Sparse快捷键 [43], IGVA [20], TGIF [23]. 为了进行公平比较,我们侧重于分享维库纳主干线和LLaVA-1.5配置的方法。

blocks.en: 4.2 Main Results
blocks.zh: 4.2 主要成果

blocks.en: Comparison with SOTA Methods. Table 1 compares DGP with mainstream MLLMs and multi-layer visual feature utilization methods under Vicuna-7B and 13B settings. Taking Vicuna-7B as an illustrative example, DGP consistently improves over the LLaVA-1.5 baseline—most prominently on VizWiz (+3.1), SQA I (+4.2), LLaVA W (+3.1), and MM-Vet (+3.3)—with similar trends on the remaining benchmarks. Against the strongest multi-layer baselines, DGP attains the best score on GQA, SQA I , SEED, LLaVA W , MM-Vet, and MMB CN , suggesting that compressing the visual hierarchy on the encoder side or using predefined sparse or hierarchical connections is insufficient to capture the full interaction between hierarchical visual evidence and the layer-wise LLM state. Overall, the gains support our central claim: dynamically gating where to connect between ViT and LLM layers is a more effective use of the visual hierarchy than any fixed wiring.
blocks.zh: 与SOTA方法的比较. 表1将DGP与Vicuna-7B和13B设置下的主流MLLMs和多层视觉特征利用方法进行比较. 以Vicuna-7B为例,DGP比LLaVA-1.5基线——最显著的是VizWiz(+3.1)、SQA I(+4.2)、LLaVA W(+3.1)和MM-Vet(+3.3)——不断改进,其余基准也有类似趋势。 在最强多层基线下,DGP在GQA,SQA I,SEED,LLAVA W,MM-Vet,和MMB CN上获得最佳分数,说明压缩编码器侧面的视觉分级或使用被预先定义的稀有或分级连接不足以捕捉分级视觉证据与分层LLM状态之间的全部相互作用. 总的来说,收益支持我们的中心主张:动态地标出VIT和LLM层之间的连接位置比任何固定接线都更有效使用视觉层次.

blocks.en: Table 2: Generalization across MLLM frameworks. We evaluate DGP on different vision encoders (SigLIP2 vs. CLIP), LLM backbones (Qwen3 vs. Vicuna), and high-resolution tiling.
blocks.zh: 表2: 跨多边土地管理框架的概况。 我们用不同的视觉编码器(SigLIP2 vs. CLIP),LLM骨干(Quen3 vs. Vicuna),高分辨平板来评价DGP.

blocks.en: Generalization Across MLLM Frameworks. To verify that DGP captures a general architectural principle, we evaluate it on two additional MLLM configurations that differ substantially in vision encoder, LLM backbone, and resolution strategy. For fair comparison, all models are trained on the same 558K (PT) + 665K (SFT) data splits following DenseConnector [ 39 ] , with one epoch per stage. As shown in Table 2 , DGP delivers consistent improvements on both Qwen3-VL-2B (SigLIP2 + Qwen3-1.7B) and LLaVA-NeXT (AnyRes tiling), confirming that the where to connect principle is architecture-agnostic.
blocks.zh: 全面推广《反洗钱法》 框架。 为了证实DGP能捕捉到一个一般的建筑原理,我们用另外两个MLLM配置来评价它,这些配置在视觉编码器,LLM主干线和分辨率策略上有很大的不同. 为了进行公平的比较,所有模型都是在同558K(PT)+665K(SFT)数据在DenseConnector [39] 后分出后进行训练,每个阶段有一个划时代. 如表2所示,DGP在Qune3-VL-2B(SigLIP2 + Qune3-1.7B)和LLaVA-NEXT(AnyRes tiling)上都提供一致的改进,证实连接原则的位置是架构-不可知.

blocks.en: Case Study. To make the effect of DGP more concrete, Figure 4 contrasts DGP with LLaVA-1.5 on math reasoning, OCR understanding, and fine-grained visual reasoning. LLaVA-1.5 frequently fails to read critical visual evidence or forms wrong semantic associations—for example, misreading menu prices or hallucinating non-existent items such as a “calzone”—and this propagates into clearly hallucinated reasoning. DGP , in contrast, uses its dynamic gated pathways to let different LLM layers access multi-granularity visual cues on demand, accurately recovering textual and numerical details, facial expressions, and other fine-grained evidence, and grounds the final answer in those cues.

blocks.en: 4.3 Ablation Studies and Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.3 研究与分析

blocks.en: Ablation of DGP Components. Table 4 ablates the two key ingredients of DGP —gated routing and entropy regularization—and keeps a uniform average over the 24 ViT layers as a control, so as to disentangle gains coming from “using more visual layers” from those coming from where to connect . Adding gated routing alone already yields consistent improvements over the LLaVA-1.5 baseline on most benchmarks. By contrast, uniform average fusion without gated routing hurts performance on most benchmarks relative to the baseline. Equal-weight mixing across the visual hierarchy appears to blend incompatible granularities and weaken fine-grained evidence, whereas gated routing keeps connectivity selective and conditioned on the language-layer state. Stacking the entropy regularizer on top of gated routing brings a further gain, indicating that a well-spread routing distribution prevents collapse onto a few visual layers and stabilizes training. Together, these results show that the improvement is driven by the where to connect mechanism—routing that adapts to the language-layer state—rather than by the mere availability of more visual features.
blocks.zh: DGP组件的校正。 表4将DGP的两个关键成分——有线和有线规范化——减少,并保持24个ViT层的统一平均值作为控制,以便将“使用更多视觉层”所产生的收益与来自何处的连接层分开。 仅仅增加有门的路线就已经比大多数基准的LLaVA-1.5基线有了持续改善。 相形之下,没有门径线的统一平均聚变会损害大多数基准相对于基线的性能。 跨视觉结构的等重混合似乎混合了互不相容的颗粒,并削弱了精细分辨的证据,而有门径的接通则有选择地保持连接,并以语言层状态为条件. 将肽常态器堆放在有门的通路上方可带来进一步收益,表明通路分布良好的能防止倒塌到几个视觉层上并稳定训练. 这些结果加在一起表明,这种改进的驱动力是连接机制——适应语言层次状态的路由——而不是仅仅因为有更多视觉特征。

blocks.en: Figure 6: Task-aware routing for the same image. As the question changes, routing shifts: attribute recognition activates shallower layers, while global-semantic questions activate deeper ones.
blocks.zh: 图6:相同图像的任务感通路. 随着问题的变化,路由转移:属性识别激活了更浅层,而全球语义问题激活了更深层.

blocks.en: Figure 7: Fused visual feature visualization. We compare CLIP layer 23, the uniform average over all 24 ViT layers, and DGP ’s gated fusion at different LLM layers.
blocks.zh: 图7:引信视觉特征可视化。 我们比较了CLIP 第23层、所有24个VIT层的统一平均值以及DGP在不同LLM层的入门聚变。

blocks.en: Layer-wise Gated Pathway Analysis. To inspect what DGP actually learns, we visualize the routing weights of every LLM layer over the ViT layers. Figure 5 (A) shows a clearly non-uniform, layer-dependent distribution: DGP neither fixates on the last ViT layer nor degenerates into a uniform average. Middle ViT layers are activated most frequently, suggesting that they offer a useful trade-off between local structure and high-level semantics. Shallow and deep features are also selected by certain LLM layers, confirming that the model dynamically reaches into different visual granularities according to where it is in decoding rather than relying on a single visual layer.
blocks.zh: 图层 Gated 路径分析 。 为了检查DGP实际学到了什么, 我们可视化每个LLM层的路由权重 在VIT层。 图5(A)显示的分布明显不统一,依地层而定:DGP既非固定在上一个维T层上,也非退化为统一平均值. 中间 ViT层最常被激活,这表明它们为本地结构和高层次语义提供了有益的取舍. 浅而深的特征也由某些LLM地层所选择,证实模型能动态地到达不同的视觉颗粒,这取决于其解码位置,而不是依赖单一的视觉地层.

blocks.en: Figure 5 (B) zooms in on representative LLM layers. Their routing curves peak at different positions: LLM layer 1 favors shallow-to-middle ViT layers, LLM layer 20 leans toward shallow features, whereas LLM layers 22 and 32 peak at mid-deep and deep ViT layers, respectively. The curves are typically multimodal rather than unimodal or flat, showing that DGP selectively combines several visual layers per LLM layer and that different LLM layers prefer different visual granularities depending on their language state. These visualizations confirm that DGP discovers non-uniform, dynamic ViT–LLM connection patterns, exploiting the complementarity of the visual hierarchy.
blocks.zh: 图5(B)放大了具有代表性的LLM层。 它们的通向曲线在不同位置上达到峰值:LLM 第1层偏好浅至中相的VIT地层,LLM 第20层偏重于浅相特征,而LLM 第22层和32层则分别位于中深相的VIT地层. 曲线一般为多模式而非单模式或平面,显示DGP有选择地将每个LLM层的多层可视化结合,不同的LLM层则根据语言状态选择不同的可视化颗粒. 这些可视化证实了DGP发现了非统一,动态的VIT-LLM连接模式,利用了可视分级的互补性.

blocks.en: Task-aware Gated Pathway Analysis. We next ask whether the routing also adapts to the task itself. Figure 5 (C) plots the routing weights of LLM layer 21 across benchmarks: each benchmark induces a distinct visual-layer profile. LLaVA W and VizWiz allocate more mass to mid-level features, in line with the need to balance object-level semantics and local visual cues for open-ended QA and real-world understanding, whereas SQA I additionally puts noticeable weight on shallow ViT layer 2, reflecting the fine-grained details required in scientific reasoning. Figure 5 (D) zooms one level further down: even within a single benchmark, individual samples exhibit substantial routing diversity, indicating that DGP ’s adaptivity goes beyond benchmark-level differences and operates at the sample level.
blocks.zh: 任务意识Gated路径分析. 我们接下来问路线是否也适应任务本身. 图5(C)绘制了跨基准的LLM 第21层的路由权重:每个基准引出一个独特的视觉层剖面. 拉脱维亚 W和VizWiz为中层特征分配了更多的质量,这符合在对象级语义和局部视觉提示之间保持平衡以进行开放式QA和现实世界的理解的需要,而SQA I则额外地将显著的分量放在了浅的ViT 第2层上,反映了科学推理中所需的精细细节. 图5(D)将一个层次进一步缩小:即使在一个单一基准范围内,单个样本也显示出相当多的路由多样性,表明DGP的可适应性超越了基准层次的差异,并在样本一级运作。

blocks.en: Figure 6 fixes the image and varies the question. For questions about attribute recognition or small-region details, DGP activates shallow or shallow-to-middle ViT features—layers that preserve edges, textures and local spatial structure. For questions that rely more on global semantics or abstract reasoning—painting identification, historical significance, action understanding—the routing weight peaks instead at mid-deep or deep ViT layers. For open-ended questions such as “describe the image in detail,” which require both local details and holistic semantics, the routing distribution naturally widens into a broader multimodal shape that simultaneously taps multiple visual hierarchies. These patterns indicate that DGP ’s routing is dynamically conditioned on the layer-wise linguistic context and semantic state of the LLM, rather than being determined solely by fixed visual-layer priors.
blocks.zh: 图6 修正图像并更改问题。 对于属性识别或小区域细节的问题,DGP激活了浅或浅至中维T特征——保存边缘、纹理和地方空间结构的层层. 对于更依赖于全球语义或抽象推理的问题——绘画识别,历史意义,动作理解——取而代之的是中深或深维特层的路由重量峰. 对于诸如“详细描述图像”等需要当地细节和整体语义的开放式问题,路线分布自然会扩大,形成一个更广泛的多模式形状,同时挖掘多种视觉分级。 这些模式表明,DGP的路由在动态上以LLM的分层语言上下文和语义状态为条件,而不是完全由固定的视觉层前作决定.

blocks.en: Feature Visualization. Figure 7 compares fixed single-layer CLIP features (L23), a uniform average over all 24 ViT layers, and the features produced by DGP at different LLM layers. CLIP (L23) yields coarse spatial responses with noisy activations in the background; naive average fusion brings in multi-layer information but, because features at different semantic granularities are superposed without selection, still suffers from diffuse responses and amplified local noise. DGP ’s LLM-layer-specific features instead show clearly more stable spatial structure, sharper subject contours, and lower background noise, preserving local details such as spoon edges and building boundaries. Crucially, the fused features differ across LLM layers 1, 18, and 28, confirming that DGP generates differentiated visual representations via dynamic routing rather than collapsing into a fixed averaging pattern. Overall, DGP strengthens global semantics while keeping shallow and middle-layer cues intact, mitigating both the information bottleneck of fixed single-layer features and the noise accumulation of naive averaging.
blocks.zh: 特色可视化. 图7比较了固定单层CLIP特征(L23),所有24个VIT层的统一平均值,以及DGP在不同LLM层产生的特征. CLIP(L23)产生粗糙的空间反应,在背景中产生噪音活化;天真平均聚变带来多层信息,但因为不同语义颗粒的特征未经选择被叠加,仍然受到散射反应和被放大的局部噪音的影响. blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: In this work, we reframe visual information injection in MLLMs around the question of where to connect , and argue that fixed single-layer inputs or predefined sparse or hierarchical connections cannot match the differentiated demands of hierarchical ViT representations and layer-wise LLM semantics. We answer this question with DGP (Dynamic Gated Pathways), an all-to-all cross-layer connection mechanism in which each LLM layer adaptively gates its preference over every ViT layer based on its current semantic state, integrating multi-granularity visual information on demand at every decoding depth. DGP delivers consistent gains across a broad set of multimodal benchmarks, while routing analyses and feature visualizations show that it learns interpretable, layer-dependent connection patterns that explain where the gains come from.
blocks.zh: 在这部作品中,我们围绕连接地点的问题重新构建了MLLMs中的视觉信息注入,并主张固定的单层输入或预定义的稀有或分级连接不能匹配分级的VIT表示和分层的LLM语义的不同要求. 我们用DGP(Dynamic Gated Pathways)来回答这个问题,这是一个全相通的跨层连接机制,在这个机制中,每个LLM层会根据其目前的语义状态,适应性地打开它相对于每个ViT层的偏好,将每个解码深度的需求上的多角度视觉信息融合在一起. DGP通过一系列广泛的多式联运基准提供一致的收益,而路由分析和特征可视化则表明,它学习了可解释的、依层而定的连接模式,从而解释收益来自何处。

blocks.en: As shown in the table, the glimpse token is inserted immediately before the answer tokens (sequence format: v...v t...t g a...a ), allowing it to attend to all visual and textual context under causal attention. At each LLM layer, the hidden state at the glimpse position queries the CLS summaries of all 24 ViT layers to produce layer-specific routing weights, which are then used to perform a weighted fusion over the original 1024-dimensional patch features. The fused features are projected to 4096 dimensions by a layer-specific projector and injected into the visual token hidden states via gated residual connections. This mechanism enables each LLM layer to adaptively select the visual granularity that best matches its current semantic state.

blocks.en: Backbone Selection Rationale. Our primary experiments are conducted under the LLaVA-1.5 framework, which remains a widely adopted open-source baseline in the research community. Specifically, we select Vicuna-v1.5 (7B/13B) as the LLM backbone and adopt the standard LLaVA-1.5 training data (LLaVA-558K for PT and LLaVA-mixed-665K for SFT). This design choice serves two purposes: (i) reproducibility , as all components are publicly available and well-documented; and (ii) fair comparison with modern multi-layer visual fusion methods (e.g., MMFuser [ 4 ] , IGVA [ 20 ] , TGIF [ 23 ] ) that likewise build upon LLaVA-1.5. By holding the backbone architecture, training data, and recipe constant, any observed performance improvement can be cleanly attributed to the proposed DGP module itself, rather than to differences in the underlying LLM, vision encoder, or training corpus.

blocks.en: A natural question is whether unfreezing the vision encoder during training could further improve performance. Table 10 compares DGP with frozen versus unfrozen ViT. Interestingly, unfreezing the ViT leads to performance drops on most benchmarks (e.g., GQA, VQA v2 , VizWiz, SEED I , POPE), while only MMB shows improvement.

blocks.en: We attribute this to a key property of our method: the dynamic routing mechanism relies on the stable semantic hierarchy across ViT layers—shallow layers encode textures and edges, while deeper layers capture high-level semantics. This layerwise division of labor is established during CLIP’s large-scale pre-training on 400M image-text pairs. When the ViT is fine-tuned on our comparatively smaller dataset, this hierarchical structure may drift, causing the router to “chase a moving target.” In contrast, freezing the ViT provides a stable visual foundation, allowing the router and fusion modules to learn consistent layer-selection strategies.
blocks.zh: 我们将此归因于我们方法的关键属性:活性路由机制依赖于跨VIT层的稳定语义分层——shallow分层编码纹理和边缘,而更深层则捕捉高层次语义. 这种分层分工是在CLIP对400M图像文本配对的大规模预训中确立的. 当我们比较小的数据集上微调ViT时,这种分级结构可能会漂移,导致路由器“追寻移动的目标”。 相形之下,被冻结的VIT提供了稳定的视觉基础,使路由器和聚变模块能够学习一致的地层选择策略.

Findings. As shown in Table 12 , (i) Learned > > Baseline > > Uniform : Dynamic routing consistently outperforms both single-layer baseline and naive averaging, confirming the necessity of selective multi-layer fusion.
(ii) Reversed degrades but does not collapse : Since each LLM layer still accesses the same ViT layers via its trained router, performance remains above Uniform. However, perturbing the weight distribution leads to consistent degradation (e.g., LLaVA W : 66.5 → \to 57.0, MMB: 66.7 → \to 61.7).
These results demonstrate that performance depends not only on which ViT layers are accessible, but also on how they are weighted, providing causal evidence that the routing patterns are functionally meaningful.

发现 如表12所示,(一) " 学到 " > 基线 > > 统一:动态的路由一贯优于单层基线和天真平均,证实了选择性多层聚变的必要性.
(二) 反向降解但不会倒塌: 由于每个LLM层仍然通过经过训练的路由器访问同样的VIT层,性能仍然高于Unific. 然而,扰动重量分布会导致持续降解(例如:LLaVA W:66.5 →\to 57.0,MMB:66.7 →\to 61.7)。
这些结果表明,性能不仅取决于哪些ViT地层是可访问的,而且还取决于它们是如何被加权的,从而提供了因果证据,证明路由模式在功能上是有意义的.

blocks.en: Appendix F Limitations and Future Work
blocks.zh: 附录F 限制和未来的工作

blocks.en: The Dynamic Gated Pathways module is designed to be plug-and-play : it introduces only lightweight, layer-wise routing components that interface with the LLM hidden states, without modifying the vision encoder or the LLM architecture itself. This modularity suggests that DGP should generalize across vision encoders and LLM backbones, adaptively selecting appropriate visual granularities regardless of the specific encoder–decoder pairing.
blocks.zh: Dynamic Gated Pathways模块被设计为插接和游戏:它只引入了轻量级,分层的路由组件,与LLM隐藏状态相接,而无需修改视觉编码器或LLM架构本身. 这种模块化表示,DGP应该将全视觉编码器和LLM主干线进行通俗化,无论具体的编码器-解码器对等,都适应性地选择适当的视觉颗粒.

blocks.en: In this work, we validate DGP primarily under the LLaVA-1.5 setting (CLIP + Vicuna-7B/13B) and further on smaller-scale alternative frameworks, including Qwen3-VL-2B (SigLIP2 + Qwen3-1.7B) and LLaVA-NeXT (AnyRes tiling). Due to resource and time constraints, however, experiments on larger LLMs (30B+), broader families of vision encoders, and larger-scale multimodal corpora remain limited. Extending validation along these axes constitutes our primary future work. We anticipate that the dynamic routing mechanism will remain effective—and potentially more beneficial—as model capacity and data scale increase, since richer language representations should enable even finer-grained visual-layer selection.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们主要在LLAVA-1.5设定(CLIP + Vicuna-7B/13B)下验证DGP,并进一步验证更小规模的替代框架,包括Qune3-VL-2B(SigLIP2 + Qune3-1.7B)和LLAVA-NEXT(AnyRes tiling). 然而,由于资源和时间的限制,大型有限责任公司(30B+)的实验、更广泛的视觉编码系统以及规模更大的多模式公司仍然有限。 沿着这些轴线扩大鉴定范围是我们今后的主要工作。 我们预计,随着模型能力和数据规模的扩大,动态路由机制将依然有效,而且可能更有利,因为较丰富的语言表述应能够更精细地选择视觉层。

blocks.en: Appendix G Broader Impacts
blocks.zh: 附录G 更广泛的影响

blocks.en: This work improves hierarchical visual access in MLLMs, which may benefit applications such as accessibility tools and educational assistants. At the same time, stronger visual reasoning could be misused for surveillance or misleading content, and DGP may inherit biases from the pretrained vision and language backbones it fine-tunes. We therefore view DGP as an architectural improvement for research use under the licenses and safety practices of the host models.
blocks.zh: 这项工作改善了MLLMs的分级视觉访问,这可能有利于无障碍工具和教育助理等应用. 同时,更强的视觉推理可能会被滥用于监视或误导内容,而DGP可能继承其被事先训练的视觉和语言骨干所形成的偏差. 因此,我们认为DGP是一种建筑改进,根据东道主模型的许可证和安全做法,可以用于研究。

blocks.en: Appendix H Use of Large Language Models
blocks.zh: 附录H 大语言模型的使用

blocks.en: For transparency, we disclose that general-purpose large language models (LLMs) were used during the preparation of this manuscript solely as writing-assistance tools to improve the clarity, concision, and grammaticality of the text. Their use was restricted to language-level editing: rewriting sentences for readability, tightening phrasing, polishing transitions, and correcting typos. No LLM was used to generate scientific claims, design experiments, produce technical content, or decide on methodology; all results, figures, analyses, and conclusions were conceived and verified by the authors, who take full responsibility for the content of every paragraph.
blocks.zh: 为了透明起见,我们披露,在编写这份手稿时,仅将通用大型语言模型用作文字协助工具,以提高文本的清晰度、精度和语法。 其使用仅限于语言层面的编辑:为可读性重写句子,收紧用词,打磨过渡,并校正打字. 没有使用LLM来产生科学主张、设计实验、产生技术内容或决定方法;所有结果、数字、分析和结论都由作者构思和核实,作者对每一段的内容负起全部责任。
